description:
The plots illustrate Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of a Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis is labeled “epoch”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 8, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “WER”, has a linear scale, ranges from approximately 20 to 42.5, and has tick labels at intervals of 2.5. 

The first line, colored blue with triangle markers and a solid line, starts at approximately 40.5 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 32 at epoch 8. The second line, colored green with circle markers and a solid line, begins at approximately 37 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 30 at epoch 8. The third line, colored red with square markers and a dashed line, starts at approximately 39 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 31 at epoch 8. The fourth line, colored magenta with diamond markers and a dashed line, begins at approximately 36 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 28 at epoch 8.
